_default_model_language: The one declaration of the default language. Every path that selects a language without being told reads this flag; exactly one pack may set it.
_인코더: Character encoder settings, the same lightweight CPU encoder the Korean pack declares. Thresholds were calibrated on Korean graphs; English routing thresholds are not calibrated.

관계해석._설명: Rules are annotated examples. Word order and prepositions mark the roles; there are no particles. Answers are realized from the query's own render, never looked up.

context_replies.unmeasured_condition: I could not weigh the condition you gave: "{말}". I found no value in this conversation to compare it with, so I did not decide whether what follows it happened, and the values it touches stay open.
context_replies.input_understanding_failed: I could not find what this sentence is about. Please say the fact you want used, or what you want to know, more plainly.
context_replies.corrected: I corrected the earlier statement you named and recomputed what follows it.
context_replies.correction_invalid: Please give the earlier sentence and the new fact. Form: correct: earlier sentence => new sentence
context_replies.unresolved: What this conversation has established is not enough to decide the answer.
context_replies.unread_event: Something earlier in this conversation is still not understood, so I cannot fix the current value: "{말}". If you rephrase it I will continue.
context_replies.unknown_word: There is a word I do not know yet: "{말}". If you tell me what it means I will continue.
context_replies.unfilled_role: I read what happened but one role is still empty: "{말}". {물음} A short answer is enough.
context_replies.unknown_basis: I cannot tell what amount this is part of: "{말}". Tell me the base amount and I will continue.
context_replies.indivisible_amount: That amount does not divide evenly: "{말}". Whether it can be split is not mine to decide; tell me how many and I will continue.
context_replies.unknown_lookup: This action needs a state I did not find in this conversation: "{말}". Tell me the current place or value and I will continue.
context_replies.ambiguous_lookup: This action could read several states: "{말}". Please say which one.
context_replies.relation_choice: There are several relations between the same people: "{말}". Please say which one (for example: the first).
context_replies.condition_false: The condition does not hold in the current state, so the action was not carried out: "{말}".
context_replies.filled_role: I filled the role I asked about and applied it to that event. If this is a new event, please say so.
context_replies.unsettled_event: An event still has an empty role, so I cannot fix the current value: "{말}". Fill the '{자리}' role and I will continue.
context_replies.conflicting_definition: A value differs from the one the definition fixes: "{말}". The definition says '{정한값}' but you said '{온값}'. How far does that go? — this time only · from now on · correction
context_replies.conflicting_event: An event disagrees with its definition, so I cannot fix the current value: "{말}". The definition says '{정한값}' but you said '{온값}'.
context_replies.extra_argument: There is a role the definition does not cover: "{말}". I do not know how to count '{남은}'.
context_replies.extra_event: An event has a role the definition does not cover, so I cannot fix the current value: "{말}". I do not know how to count '{남은}'.
context_replies.too_many_readings: There are too many ways to split this: "{말}". I cannot call the one I saw correct, so no value is fixed. Please say it in shorter parts.
context_replies.unreadable_definition: I heard the explanation but cannot read it yet: "{몸통}". It contains an action I do not know. Please restate it with words I know.
context_replies.invalid: The earlier state and the new condition cannot both apply. Please check the condition.
context_replies.capacity: This conversation reached its state limit. Please restate the conditions in a new conversation.
context_replies.which_event: I asked about several events, so I do not know which one this answers: {목록}. Please say which event.
context_replies.which_referent: I do not know what '{말}' refers to. Which of {목록} do you mean?
context_replies.no_referent: I found nothing in this conversation that '{말}' refers to.
context_replies.role_mismatch: "{말}" does not seem to answer the role I asked about. {물음} If '{값}' is right for it, please say so.
context_replies.answer_unclear: I did not take "{말}" as an answer. {물음} One name is enough.
context_replies.contradiction: As stated, the numbers do not add up: "{말}". The starting amount may differ, or something in between may be missing. Please say which to correct.
context_replies.conflict_scope_unclear: I did not understand how far "{말}" goes. Please answer with one of: this time only · from now on · correction
context_replies.correction_target: What should I correct? — the explanation · the event
context_replies.missing_premise: This conversation never said the {관계} of {대상}, so I did not answer.
context_replies.explain_nothing: There is no earlier answer or correction in this conversation to explain.
context_replies.explain_correction: Because of the correction "{정정}". I corrected the same event: "{전사건}" → "{후사건}" (amount {전} → {후}; no new transfer was carried out). Rules applied: {규칙}. Statements used: {근거}. Result: {목록}.{수선}
context_replies.explain_answer: Why "{물음}" was answered "{답}". Rules applied: {규칙}. Statements used: {근거}. Changes: {목록}.{수선}
context_replies.explain_repairs: Of these, read through a repair: {목록}.
context_replies.other_than_confirm: If '{말}' is {제외}, the other person is {다른}. Please confirm you mean {다른} — I have not assumed it.
context_replies.reference_corrected: I corrected the same event (no new event added): "{사건}", amount {전} → {후}. Recomputed state: {목록}.
context_replies.reference_no_event: I found no earlier event in this conversation that "{말}" refers to, so nothing was corrected.
context_replies.reference_which_event: "{말}" could refer to several events, so I did not choose: {목록}.
context_replies.reference_value_unclear: I could not find a single place for the value {전} in "{사건}", so nothing was corrected.
context_replies.repair_ambiguous: [held] "{원문}": several repairs of the same cost read it differently, so I did not choose — {목록}.
context_replies.repair_over_bound: [held] "{원문}": placing it under the nearest rule "{규칙}" needs {수선}. Cost {비용} is over the bound {한도}, so it was not applied.
context_replies.repair_unplaced: [held] "{원문}": no declared rule fits within cost bound {한도}, so it was not applied.

concept_reason_render: Event '$event' follows the learned structure ($structure); with the separate premise '$premise' and pack rule $rule (definition v$definition_version, rule v$rule_version) I concluded '$conclusion'.
concept_reason_missing_render: I did not decide from the learned event structure alone. The separate premise '$premise' it needs is not established.
concept_reason_negative_render: I did not decide from the learned event structure alone. The separate premise '$premise_label' ($premise) was explicitly denied.
concept_reason_conflict_render: I did not decide from the learned event structure alone. Support for and against the separate premise '$premise_label' ($premise) conflicts.
concept_reason_unavailable_render: The separate premise is established, but no active learned concept applies to this event, so I did not decide.
관계해석._event_reference: An earlier event is named back by its verb's participle (the one given) or past form (the one Haru gave). The forms are computed from the declared lexicon.

문장분리._설명: Clause boundaries are punctuation and declared connectives. A comma splits only when the part before it is a complete clause.

활용._설명: Only declared verbs inflect. Irregular forms are listed in the lexicon; a verb not listed takes the declared regular suffix. Nothing is guessed from an input word.

_자리조사: English marks roles by position and prepositions, not particles.
_부정: Negation of events is not declared for English yet; negated sentences are not read as events.
_지시어: Words that point back at something already said in this conversation. When several things fit, ask; never pick.

군말._설명: Sentence-initial words that carry no content. The original text still competes; a reading without them is only an extra candidate.

문서분류._설명: Surface shapes of English document sentences.

_이음어미: English joins clauses with words, not endings; this never matches.

생략._설명: coordination: a conjunct after a comma that leaves out the trailing words of the previous conjunct's subject inherits them (Minsu has five apples, and Jiyeon has two -> Jiyeon apples). part_reference: naming only the leading word of a known subject names that subject when exactly one fits.

수선._설명: Edits that bring an unmatched clause to the nearest declared rule. Only typed words move, drop or swap; nothing untyped and undeclared is added. Over the bound the clause is held and the needed edit is named.

답못함._설명: What to say when no answer is given. Not knowing, not being able to, and being off topic are said apart.
답못함.ask_more: Could you say a little more about what you are asking?
답못함.off_topic: This knowledge pack does not cover that topic. It is outside the graphs I have.
답못함.uncertain_topic: There is a nearby topic, but I am not sure it is the one. Could you say a bit more?
답못함.no_evidence: I know the topic, but the graph has no evidence for this question. I only answer from what I have.
답못함.web_no_source:
## Answer from web sources

I found no source text that could be verified.
답못함.web_intro: The KG does not have enough evidence, so here are sentences checked in the source text.
답못함.argument_no_evidence: I found no evidence in the selected KG that exactly matches the question. I do not answer from similarity alone.
답못함.web_learn_failed: I could not build complete knowledge from two different source texts.
답못함.no_graph_selected: I could not choose a KG for this question.
답못함.plan_no_topic: No topic to learn could be taken from the question, so no knowledge is stored
답못함.plan_no_sources: There are not two different source texts, so no knowledge is stored

뜻고리._설명: Word -> language-neutral concept id. Converted from docs/ko/english-pack-preparation/02-sense-links-ko-en.json: only verified, same_concept, entity links. Candidates, held links and homonym splits were not carried over.

_조사: English has no particle agreement. Both tables stay empty and the engine skips that step.
